description: Parser for the client for the realtime Engine
name: engine.io-parser
scripts: {'compile': 'rimraf ./build && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && ./postcompile.sh', 'test': 'npm run format:check && npm run compile && if test "$BROWSERS" = "1" ; then npm run test:browser; else npm run test:node; fi', 'test:node': 'nyc mocha -r ts-node/register test/index.ts', 'test:browser': 'zuul test/index.ts --no-coverage', 'format:check': "prettier --check 'lib/**/*.ts' 'test/**/*.ts'", 'format:fix': "prettier --write 'lib/**/*.ts' 'test/**/*.ts'", 'prepack': 'npm run compile'}
